gloss: by nature; from birth; innate quality

definitions.gloss: by nature; from birth; innate quality
definitions.explanation: A quality, trait, or condition that a person has had since birth, as opposed to something acquired later in life. Used both as a noun (meaning 'natural disposition') and as an adverb (meaning 'from birth').

examples.japanese: {生|う}まれつき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}できない→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't succeed on innate talent alone.

examples.japanese: {生|う}まれつき⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}かった→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧になった。
examples.english: I was frail from birth, but I became healthy by continuing to exercise.

notes:
Combines ⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ (to be born) with つき (attached/inherent). Can function as a noun modifying another noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({生|う}まれつき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ 'innate personality') or as an adverb directly modifying a predicate ({生|う}まれつき⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧ 'naturally fast on one's feet').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|う}まれつき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: innate talent
- {生|う}まれつき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: natural temperament
- {生|う}まれつき⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: physically frail from birth
- {生|う}まれつき⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: born with poor eyesight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先天的|せんてんてき}: congenital, innate — more formal and medical/academic in tone
- ⟦{天性|てんせい}→天性：23367_tensei⟧: natural gift, innate nature — literary, often used for positive traits
- ⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: born with — a verbal phrase with the same meaning
